culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Shinya Kadokura. The consequence he suffered from the failed investment was that his house, his wife, and his daughter were taken away, but Zaizen was enriched because of the investment. Kadokura blames Kogoro because if he didn't arrive, the case hasn't been solved exactly at midnight.

summary.en: During the reconstruction of the traditional house inn, the inn hostess found a strange safe, so she called in two experts to check it out: The antique appraiser Seiji Kawabata and the secondhand dealer Shinya Kadokuya, who brought in their friend Ippei Zaizen. The reason Kogoro is here is because the owner received a message threatening to take the treasure.

suspects: Seiji Kawabata, Shinya Kadokura, Kyoko Tominaga, and possible outsider
